proven: The public paper repository began on 2025-12-09 and its first substantive analysis notebook preceded the Point_data artifact by about 1 minute 43 seconds.
Point_data.pkl was uploaded as a standalone binary artifact; the public December repository history contains no producer notebook/script before that upload.

The later public PP3 notebook explicitly creates Reduced_dendrites by subtree extraction followed by reduction.
The public algorithmic morphology-to-root-coordinate path is therefore reconstructed, but its exact December 2025 revision is not recovered.
The public Git DAG exposes two parallel Point_data upload commits with the same parent, same tree, and identical blob, followed by a merge that preserves the same tree.

interpretation.historical_boundary: The public repository proves an ingest/publication boundary at 2025-12-09T19:41:50Z for Point_data.pkl and proves a local consumer path that already existed immediately beforehand. The producer itself must therefore be outside the public paper-repository history before that boundary, unless it existed only in an unexposed private/local environment. Later public preprocessing notebooks reconstruct the algorithmic path but do not recover the exact December 2025 producer.
interpretation.confidence_upgrade: The temporal ordering now rules out a common overclaim: the December Point_data binary was not demonstrably produced by a producer script committed earlier in the public paper repository, because that repository did not contain such a producer before the artifact upload. The strongest public evidence is consumption lineage plus later executable reconstruction, not exact producer identity.
